title: MABPD: Multi-Agent Bias Probing & Detection via Structured Argument Debate

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating a multi-agent LLM pipeline's ability to detect loaded language, selective framing, and strategic omission in news articles using the expert-annotated BABE (Bias Annotations By Experts) benchmark.
Assessing the system's zero-shot accuracy in identifying hyperpartisan political framing, ideological labeling, and left/right-leaning perspectives using the SemEval 2019 HyperPartisan news corpus.
